alt: Open PS4 game cases with physical Blu-ray discs visible for The Witcher: Wild Hunt and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, surrounded by more physical game cases
credit: Stanislav Kogiku/SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images
story: Sony announced physical PlayStation game disc production ends January 2028 — despite 82% of PS5 consoles sold having disc drives — while simultaneously unveiling a Sony Electronics vinyl turntable for music fans who love physical media.
why_funny: Sony supports physical media in exactly one format: the one PlayStation doesn't use.
